title: Gemma 4 E2B/E4B adaptation frontier, controls, composition, and runtime closure
question: Which deeper Gemma 4 E2B and E4B adaptation findings survive scorer, mechanism, seed, retention, multimodal-path, export, serving, and paired-MTP controls, and which important directions remain weak, contradictory, or unmeasured?

inclusion_criteria: Exact Gemma 4 E2B or E4B adaptation subject with a method, retained artifact, issue reproducer, or measured outcome.
Evidence that exposes at least one useful control across scorer, mechanism, seed, data, retention, target topology, export, serving, or MTP pairing.
Negative or contradictory results retained when their configuration and denominator improve the research method.
Current issue and pull-request state retained separately from merged, released, and independently rerun states.
exclusion_criteria: Generic tuning guidance without an exact Gemma 4 E2B or E4B binding.
Training loss, adapter load success, HTTP health, or nominal context treated as semantic acceptance.
Dependent retellings counted as independent origin groups.
Cross-size rankings assembled from incompatible tasks, scorers, runtimes, or denominators.

generality_probe.rationale: The run deliberately crosses research papers, executable artifacts, upstream failures, corrected instruments, and serving surfaces so that no one task or framework defines a family-wide conclusion.

clusters.label: Scorer, mechanism, and adjudicator are independent outcome axes
clusters.supported_scope: Across one E2B controlled study, one E4B DPO study, and one E2B artifact suite, the scorer or judge changes the magnitude and sometimes the direction of an adaptation conclusion.
transfer_limits: The studies use different tasks and do not quantify one portable scorer-bias rate.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Independent human or held-out scorers are absent from part of the corpus.
clusters.next_action: Require alternative scorer and intervention controls in adaptation studies whose primary metric also shaped training or selection.

clusters.label: Data, capacity, checkpoint selection, and adapter strength are coupled
clusters.supported_scope: Three independent E4B origins show that rank, learning rate, data quality, epoch, masks, merge algorithm, and adapter strength can move task and retention outcomes separately.
transfer_limits: No shared factorial experiment spans the three tasks or establishes universal settings.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Multi-seed rank-by-learning-rate and merge-strength sweeps remain sparse.
clusters.next_action: Design disjoint-development selection with a common task plus orthogonal-retention suite.

clusters.label: Reward design can unlock relative gain without clearing absolute acceptance
clusters.supported_scope: Within the retained E2B NLA experiment, dense reward improves routing and rank measurements after sparse regimes fail, while judge disagreement and the absolute rubric prevent a broader capability conclusion.
transfer_limits: One experiment origin cannot establish recurring E2B GRPO behavior.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: The strongest checkpoint lacks independent seeds and external replication.
clusters.next_action: Repeat the dense-reward route with multiple seeds, a frozen absolute bar, and independent adjudication.

clusters.label: Target selection and multimodal data flow need direct instrumentation
clusters.supported_scope: Across training and serving surfaces, exact model identity and error-free execution do not prove that the intended language, audio, or vision path was selected and exercised.
transfer_limits: Exact namespaces and counts remain framework- and revision-specific.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: A framework-neutral end-to-end tower and gradient probe is not yet retained.
clusters.next_action: Prototype a generic batch-key, token-expansion, forward-hook, gradient, and counterfactual acceptance probe outside the production validator.

clusters.label: Load, health, export, and semantic application are separate states
clusters.supported_scope: Independent runtime surfaces show that successful load or HTTP health can coexist with ignored adapters or degenerate generation, so acceptance requires a deterministic semantic delta and exact artifact mapping.
transfer_limits: Current defect incidence across released runtimes and all adapter topologies is unknown.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: No public release matrix covers base, adapter, merged, quantized, and served parity for E2B and E4B.
clusters.next_action: Create a bounded semantic parity protocol and route actual runtime execution to its owner.

clusters.label: Multimodal aggregate gain hides tower, class, and format trade-offs
clusters.supported_scope: One E4B audio and one E2B vision artifact show aggregate specialization gains alongside subcategory or format regressions, while an independent framework defect proves that modality flow itself needs verification.
transfer_limits: Tasks, targets, data, and evaluation ownership differ; the cluster supports a study shape rather than a size comparison.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Neither artifact has an independent end-to-end modality and export replication.
clusters.next_action: Retain base, language-only, tower-only, joint, and modality-removed arms with per-class and structured-output metrics.

clusters.label: Post-adaptation long-context behavior remains unqualified
clusters.supported_scope: The representative E4B derivative exposes short training and an explicit lack of formal long-reasoning evaluation despite a configurable large serving window.
transfer_limits: Finite search coverage cannot prove the absence of qualifying evidence elsewhere.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: No retained post-adaptation position-sensitive or long-reasoning curve for E2B or E4B.
clusters.next_action: Repeat targeted searches and prioritize a direct shared-context-length experiment.

clusters.label: Adapted target and MTP drafter must be accepted as an exact pair
clusters.supported_scope: One exact fine-tuned E4B derivative and official assistant pair has measured corrected throughput, while neighboring runtime failures prevent transfer to arbitrary adapters or releases.
transfer_limits: The result is bounded to the named derivative, drafter, patch, vLLM revision, hardware, prompts, and draft depths.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: No E2B pair or general LoRA-versus-joint-tuning matrix exists.
clusters.next_action: Build a target/drafter matrix with deterministic parity, corrected token counters, acceptance, and workload curves.

tensions.label: Relative dense-reward gain versus absolute usability
tensions.analysis: Routing and percentile improve, but top-1 is non-monotonic, judges disagree, and no checkpoint clears the external absolute rubric; these instruments answer different questions.
tensions.remaining_question: Can a multi-seed dense-reward E2B run improve both relative rank and a frozen absolute task bar?

tensions.label: Measured adapter artifact versus silent runtime no-op
tensions.analysis: Task and retention deltas exist for exact artifacts, but a different runtime can load Gemma 4 LoRA without applying it, so artifact evidence cannot be projected through an unverified serving path.
tensions.remaining_question: Which released serving configurations preserve each named artifact's deterministic semantic delta?

tensions.label: Multimodal task gain versus proof that modality traversed the intended tower
tensions.analysis: Author metrics show bounded gains, but independent implementation evidence shows both accidental target selection and silent tower bypass; task results need path instrumentation before tower causality is assigned.
tensions.remaining_question: Do tower-only and modality-removed controls preserve the reported per-class gains under a verified data path?

tensions.label: Improving training proxy versus degrading held-out outcome
tensions.analysis: The document study rewards careful data and coupled optimizer diagnosis, while the wallet study directly shows that lower validation loss can select a worse OOD checkpoint; both reject single-proxy tuning but under different instruments.
tensions.remaining_question: Which development metrics predict target and retention outcomes across less template-deterministic E4B tasks?

tensions.label: MTP throughput gain versus healthy but semantically broken serving
tensions.analysis: The corrected exact pair accelerates decode, yet both its own patch controls and the wider vLLM issue show that health or load success can coexist with broken semantics.
tensions.remaining_question: Can one released runtime pass semantic parity and throughput acceptance for base, adapted target, and target-drafter pair together?

method_pressures.pressure: A source-only packet cannot distinguish a deliberately searched evidence gap from a direction the researcher never examined.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Add optional generic search probes with question, strategies, sought source roles, result state, retained refs, limitations, and next action.

method_pressures.pressure: A tuned model can gain under one parser or judge without improving the claimed mechanism, and scorer reuse can make the evaluation circular.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Separate behavioral outcome, mechanism intervention, scorer identity, judge direction, seeds, and absolute acceptance in the method.

method_pressures.pressure: Validation loss, data quality, rank, learning rate, epoch, and merge strength can disagree or interact, making best-checkpoint language ambiguous.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Require an explicit train signal, disjoint development selection, frozen held-out result, and orthogonal retention path.

method_pressures.pressure: Multimodal training and serving can remain operational while selecting the wrong modules or bypassing the intended modality tower.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Add generic silent-path checks for batch keys, placeholder expansion, tensor shapes, tower forward or gradients, target counts, and modality counterfactuals.

method_pressures.pressure: Load success, HTTP health, or merged code does not prove that a served adapter or paired drafter changes behavior correctly.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Add a distinct semantic-delta and paired-artifact acceptance stage after export and serve.

method_pressures.pressure: A metric can change because its judge fails a control or its harness counts streaming events instead of tokens, and rewriting the number would erase causal history.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Retain metric, instrument revision, discovered defect, corrected computation, rerun, and revised observation as an explicit lineage.

method_pressures.pressure: Adapter merge and target-drafter success depend on exact component bytes, weights, ordering, density, runtime, and workload rather than family labels.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Treat composition and MTP as exact multi-artifact configurations with component baselines and common acceptance suites.
